name: Darrehof
beschreibung:
Darrehof welcomes guests to idyllic Serfaus with a unique blend of authentic Tyrolean horse farm and contemporary holiday accommodations. Families and children adore the riding lessons, friendly animals, and spacious apartments.

Situated on the sun-drenched plateau of Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis, it ensures ideal conditions for winter skiing as well as diverse summer mountain explorations.
kurzbeschreibung: Darrehof in Serfaus combines farmstay charm with modern comforts and family equestrian opportunities on the sunny plateau.
